scope: Fixed sparse calibration diagnostic of stateless SAM box refinement; not continuous tracking, independent validation or production behavior
prompts: Each present original Cutie slot receives its largest8-connected-component box as a SAM prompt. No annotation boxes or future pixels. Missing original slots stay missing; anonymous slots7/8 are included.
refined_geometry: Full returned binary-mask AABB per original prompt slot, unchanged coordinate convention. No additional component cleanup, confidence sweep or pixel arbitration. Overlapping refined masks remain separate proposals and can count as duplicate errors.
names: Original known name only if original Cutie p10>=.7 and frozen quarantinev2 allows its slot. SAM probability never changes naming. No identity reassignment, new objects, gallery changes or feedback into Cutie history.
scoring: Same maximum-cardinality one-to-oneIoU>=.5 common scorer, invoked once per fixed timestamp and aggregate counts. All named unmatched boxes are errors. Labels loaded only after every refined prediction is cached.
limitations: Thirty exposed calibration frames cannot establish temporal quality or deployment performance.
Separate SAM masks may merge or duplicate nearby animals; preserve these errors.
Only CPU inference; no latency claim forMPS. No reserved frames or continuous Cutie run.
